meta.name: google-ad-scraper
meta.description: Scrape competitor ads from Google Ads by domain. Returns ad creatives, formats, and campaign details. Use for competitive ad research and messaging analysis.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 抓取竞品谷歌广告创意与投放详情
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果要做竞品广告调研或分析对手投放策略。
copy.tagline_en: Scrape competitor Google Ads creatives and campaign details.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to research competitor ads or analyze their messaging.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以按域名或公司名抓取 Google 广告，返回广告文案、格式和投放详情，用于竞品分析。
howto.when: 当你要求分析某个公司的 Google 广告策略，或提供域名/公司名时触发。

say.text: 帮我看看 hubspot.com 最近在投什么广告。
say.note: 返回该域名的广告列表。

say.text: 对比 stripe.com 和 paypal.com 的广告。
say.note: 分别抓取并对比广告内容。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can scrape Google Ads by domain or company name, returning ad creatives, formats, and campaign details for competitive analysis.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to analyze a company's Google Ads strategy, or provide a domain/company name.

say_en.text: Show me the latest ads from hubspot.com.
say_en.note: Returns ad list for that domain.

say_en.text: Compare ads from stripe.com and paypal.com.
